_source: No Trial3 manifest entry for SCAN_ASCII. IF=0/NOCONT=0/INDIC=0/TITLE=0/Y2K=0 skip the whole conditional-field-test / *CREATE SGS card-generation machinery, leaving the simplest 'TOTAL SCAN' path: every record read is unconditionally treated as found (falls straight through SUITE-RECHERCHE/FOUND-REC with no test), matching the '*IF [TITLE]>0 ... *ELSE *IF [IF]>0 CONDITIONAL *ELSE TOTAL' heading text. ASCII=1 selects the ACOB,IB / DISPLAY-1 branch. INPUT,1,1<=3 selects DISC (not UNISERVO) file assign.
